title: Complete Analytics Pipeline
desc: Filter → Group → Sort → Limit with all core syntax
query:
-- ASQL queries read top-to-bottom like a pipeline
-- Each line transforms the data from the previous step

from orders                          -- Start with a table (not SELECT)

  -- WHERE filters rows with conditions
  where status = "completed"         
    and amount > 100                  -- AND combines conditions
    and customer_id is not null       -- NULL checking
    and created_at >= @2024-01-01     -- @ prefix for date literals
    and created_at < 30 days ago      -- Natural relative dates

  -- GROUP BY with aggregates in parentheses
  group by region (
    sum_amount,                       -- Underscore shorthand: sum(amount) as sum_amount
    # as order_count,                 -- # is shorthand for COUNT(*)
    avg_amount                        -- avg(amount) as avg_amount
  )

  order by -sum_amount                -- - prefix for descending
  limit 10                            -- Top 10 regions

title: Join with Aggregation
query:
-- Join customers with their orders
-- Use & for INNER JOIN (both sides must match)
from customers
  where signup_date >= @2023-01-01
    and is_active = true
  & orders on customers.id = orders.customer_id
  group by customers.id, customers.country (
    sum orders.total as lifetime_value,
    # as total_orders,
    max orders.created_at as last_order_date
  )
  order by -lifetime_value
  limit 50

title: Left Join Pipeline
desc: Left join to include all records from left table
query:
-- &? for LEFT JOIN (right side may be NULL)
-- The ? marks the optional/nullable side
from leads
  &? opportunities on leads.id = opportunities.lead_id
  &? deals on opportunities.id = deals.opportunity_id
  where leads.source = "website"
    and leads.created_at >= @2024-01-01
  group by leads.source (
    sum deals.amount as revenue,
    # as total_leads
  )
  order by -revenue

title: String & Date Filtering
desc: Various filtering patterns: strings, dates, IN, BETWEEN
query:
-- Filtering patterns beyond basic comparisons

from users
  where status = "active"
    or status = "pending"              -- OR for alternatives
    
    and email contains "@gmail.com"    -- String matching (vs LIKE '%...%')
    and name starts with "J"           -- Also: ends with, contains
    
    and age between 18 and 65          -- BETWEEN for ranges
    and country in ("US", "UK", "CA")  -- IN for multiple values
    
    and created_at >= @2023-01-01      -- @ prefix for dates
    and last_login >= 7 days ago       -- Natural language dates
    
  order by created_at
  limit 100

title: Date Grouping
desc: Group by time periods using date functions
query:
-- Group by time periods for time-series analysis
-- month() truncates to month start
from transactions
  where status = "completed"
    and transaction_date >= @2024-01-01
  group by month(transaction_date), region (
    sum_amount,             -- Monthly revenue
    # as transaction_count, -- Transaction count
    avg_amount              -- Average transaction
  )
  order by month_transaction_date, -sum_amount

title: CTEs with stash as
query:
-- stash as creates CTEs mid-pipeline
from users
  where signup_date >= @2023-01-01
  group by country (# as user_count)
  stash as country_counts  -- Everything above becomes a CTE
  order by -user_count     -- Pipeline continues with the CTE

title: Chained Joins
desc: Multiple joins in a single pipeline
query:
-- Chain multiple joins together
-- Each join builds on the previous result
from customers
  & orders on customers.id = orders.customer_id
  & order_items on orders.id = order_items.order_id
  & products on order_items.product_id = products.id
  where orders.status = "completed"
    and orders.created_at >= @2024-01-01
  group by customers.id, customers.name (
    sum(order_items.quantity * order_items.price) as total_spent,
    # products as products_purchased
  )
  order by -total_spent
  limit 25

title: Coalesce for NULLs
query:
-- ?? is the null coalesce operator (preferred over COALESCE())
-- Returns first non-null value
from users
  select
    name ?? "Unknown" as display_name,
    email ?? "no-email@example.com" as email,
    phone ?? "N/A" as phone
